findings.title: kernel.md still guarantees both hand-offs are recognized "with no per-repo configuration at all" and that the driver "RUNS the repository's own pin freshness check", which is false now that `handoff.pin_check` defaults to `none`
lib/drive.sh:1642 "Every other proof here has no configuration at all" contradicts the opt-in pin route rewritten 30 lines below
lib/handoff.sh:197 still offers "a formula they re-pinned after re-reading the diff" as a legitimate post-ack hand-off commit, the one example PROTOCOL.md's twin sentence was changed away from
docs/troubleshooting.md:539 still instructs the operator to "Perform the hand-off (re-pin, `chmod +x`)", missed by the phrase-literal tripwire in §6

the new §6 doc tripwires use line-based `grep -Fq` on sentences that straddle a hard wrap, so an innocuous re-wrap fails every task's verification chain; test_docs.sh's folded-line idiom exists for this
